records.title: 10-K
records.text: We reported net revenues of $2.6 billion and $2.2 billion in fiscal years 2021 and 2020, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Revenue from consumer products was up 21% due to higher demand in cell phone and handheld computer products.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: During fiscal years 2021 and 2020, we had net inventory write-downs of $14.3 million and $16.5 million, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Research and development expenses were $454.3 million and $440.2 million for fiscal years 2021 and 2020, respectively, which represented 17.3% and 20.1% of net revenues, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities was $924.3 million in fiscal year 2021, an increase of $123.4 million compared with fiscal year 2020.
